title: Monotonicity of randomized verification
statement: Let $E$ be a verifier model, let $L$ be a language of bit strings, and let $p',p\in\mathbb{Q}$ satisfy $p'\le p$. If $L$ has an $E$-efficient randomized verifier with polynomially bounded randomness whose acceptance probability on members and rejection probability on nonmembers are each at least $p$, then it has such a verifier with both probabilities at least $p'$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ has an $E$-efficient verifier with polynomially bounded randomness and both correctness probabilities at least $p$
